name: Macrocell Grid Traversal with Majorant Densities
definition: A traversal method using macrocell grids that store min/max density ranges to compute extinction coefficients (majorants) for accelerated free-flight distance tracking in volumetric path tracing.
summary: Macrocell Grid Traversal with Majorant Densities accelerates volumetric path tracing by using transfer function alpha as a majorant to enable probabilistic free-flight steps within coarse spatial partitions.
